entries.text:
# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

Ndi a tanziela yawee Mudzimu wanga, uri Wo ntsika u U divha na u U luvha. Ndi tanziela zwino, u shaya nungo hanga na maanda. Au, vhushai hanga na lupfumo Lwau. A hu na munwe Mudzimu e si Iwe, Mufarisi Mihngoni, Mudiitelazwothe.
